verses.gurmukhi: ੧੮ : ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਪਿਰਮ ਰੋਸ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਹੈ ‘ਵਾਹ ਵਾਹ’
verses.translit_en: 18 : gursikh piram ros visamaadh to(n) u'chaa hai 'vaeh vaaha'

en.bdb: The loving delight of gurmukh is above all wonders

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਨੋ ਆਚਰਜੁ ਹੈ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਹੋਵੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj no aacharaj hai acharaj hova(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Even the most wonderful wonder becomes full of wonder in the presence of loving delight.
Before love, awe also feels itself full of awe.
Love makes even the surprise full of surprise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਿਗਤਹੁਂ ਅਬਿਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਹਿਂ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: abigatahu(n) abigat hai nahi(n) alakh lakha(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: Unmanifest to unmanifestation, that unperceptible Lord cannot be perceived.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਥਹੁਂ ਅਕਥ ਅਲੇਖ ਹੈ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਤਿ ਸੁਣੰਦਾ।
verses.translit_en: akathahu(n) akath alekh hai net net suna(n)dhaa|

en.bdb: He is beyond all descriptions and is known as neti neti, this is not, this is not.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਚਵੰਦਾ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras vaahu vaahu chava(n)dhaa ||18||

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is delight of love which causes him to say wondrous, wonderful!
